steps.title: Open the Desk page
steps.narration: The Desk page scans about 100 well-known stocks. It ranks each one by how close it sits to a key price level.
steps.point_out: Today's ranked list, with a fresh price reading for every row.

steps.title: See the new record of every top-up run
steps.narration: Refreshing the Desk's price data is called a "top-up." From now on, every top-up run is saved for good. Its result can never be lost.
steps.point_out: A new "Top-up Runs" panel sits at the bottom of the page. It plainly says none have been saved yet — the honest, correct starting point, not a mistake.

steps.title: Look back at a past scan
steps.narration: Every past scan is saved. Opening one shows it exactly as it was recorded, never mixed with today's numbers.
steps.point_out: A note confirming this is an older, saved scan, not today's.

expect.text: Viewing the recorded screen for 2026-06-22 — not the latest.

steps.title: Jump from a ranked stock into its chart
steps.narration: Clicking any ranked stock opens that stock's own chart, already loaded for the same date.
steps.point_out: The Structure page opens with AAPL's own chart and price-level table, both loaded for that date.

steps.title: Move to the live tape reader
steps.narration: The Desk sits alongside two other pages, all reachable from the same menu at the top.
steps.point_out: The Cockpit page opens, ready to watch a stock's price action.

steps.title: Choose the simulated tape
steps.narration: You can try the reader on a made-up stock first. No live market feed is needed.
steps.point_out: The Simulated option is now selected.

steps.title: Name the simulated ticker
steps.narration: Typing a name sets up which made-up stock the tape will follow.
steps.point_out: The ticker field now holds the name just typed.

steps.title: Watch the tape settle into a read
steps.narration: Price bars move in real time. The tape settles into a plain-English read, like "Buyer Control."
steps.point_out: The live read label above the moving price bars.

steps.title: Open the price-level map fresh
steps.narration: The Structure page maps a stock's key support and resistance levels. This time, the symbol and date are typed in by hand.
steps.point_out: An empty form, waiting for a stock symbol and a date.

steps.title: Choose a stock to map
steps.narration: Typing in a stock loads its own price levels.
steps.point_out: The Symbol field now reads AAPL.

steps.title: Choose the date to look at
steps.narration: Typing in the exact date and time to look at.
steps.point_out: The As-of field now reads the chosen date and time.

steps.title: Load its key price levels
steps.narration: Loading draws the stock's real price history with its key support and resistance levels marked on top.
steps.point_out: The chart and the level table both show a level near 300.11 — a well-known price wall for this stock.
